entries.title: New shared/core files landed

ai.title: Add Reddit subreddit campaign utilities and promotion evasion checks
ai.summary: Introduces a new module in `common/src/util/` containing helpers for Reddit campaigns that target a subreddit link instead of a fixed post. Defines `SUBREDDIT_CAMPAIGN_ACTIONS` to restrict valid actions to comment and post, and `parseSubredditUrl` to normalize various subreddit link formats into a canonical URL. Implements `subredditCampaign` to identify stored campaigns by their canonical link, action type, and preview author, and `promotionEvasionReason` to detect briefs requesting moderation evasion, extra accounts, or hidden sponsorship.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/util/reddit-campaign.ts` defines `SUBREDDIT_CAMPAIGN_ACTIONS`, `parseSubredditUrl`, `subredditCampaign`, `parseRedditThingUrl`, and `promotionEvasionReason`, which are asserted by the new test suite `common/src/util/__tests__/reddit-campaign.test.ts`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side consumer of `isSubredditCampaignSql` mentioned in the comments, nor the specific rollout schedule for this new campaign type.

eli5.text: Advertisers buying Reddit placements can now ask people to reply to a thread or start a new post in a chosen subreddit instead of pointing to one fixed link. The system includes a safety check that stops any brief asking people to sneak past moderators, use extra accounts, or hide that the post is sponsored. This is an internal update for the team that manages these ads; it does not change what you see or do in your own coding sessions.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: hosted-workspace

ai.title: Desktop cloud runtime contract adds pending move state
ai.summary: The `runtime` method of the `HostedWorkspaceHost` interface in `common/src/desktop-cloud/hosted-workspace.ts` gains an optional `pendingMove` field on its response type. This field tracks a move operation that started but did not finish, allowing the client to refuse other location changes until the pending move completes for that specific location and branch. Builds prior to November 18 omit this key, so the presence of `pendingMove` indicates a newer desktop client capable of handling incomplete state transitions.
ai.evidence: The diff in `common/src/desktop-cloud/hosted-workspace.ts` adds an optional `pendingMove` field to the `runtime` method's response type within `HostedWorkspaceHost`, defined as { location: 'local' | 'worktree' | 'cloud'; sourceBranch?: string }.

eli5.text: The shared messaging rules between the desktop app and its cloud connection now include a way to report when a move of your project between computers started but did not finish. This information is in place for the app to use, but it does not change anything you see or do yet. You will notice it in practice only after newer desktop software begins using this detail to prevent starting new actions while a stuck move is being resolved.

ai.title: Document jsdom style cache and DOM query timing rules
ai.summary: Adds documentation to `docs/testing.md` describing performance bottlenecks caused by jsdom style computation during role queries and a new helper, `freebuff/web/test/support/jsdom-style-rules.ts`, that caches built-in stylesheet matches. The update records that `getComputedStyle` calls drop from 450-650 microseconds to 80-280 microseconds per call, reducing execution time for slow test files by more than half. It also notes that faster DOM execution changes the timing constraints of tests relying on zero-delay editor timers, requiring explicit waits behind `setTimeout` calls.
ai.evidence: The diff adds 36 lines to `docs/testing.md`, documenting a new test performance pattern involving role queries, a new helper file `freebuff/web/test/support/jsdom-style-rules.ts`, and timing behaviors in `DataPane`, `DataR3`, and `workspace-app.projects-send`.

eli5.text: Only documentation changed here: reference text and guides were updated. The assistant itself works exactly as before, so there is nothing for you to do or notice.

ai.title: Add Discord presence capability to desktop workspace contract
ai.summary: The shared desktop-cloud contract gains an optional Discord presence capability on the workspace host interface. The new optional property allows the hosted renderer to query and set the status of the "Playing Freebuff" Rich Presence feature in Settings. According to the comment, builds without this feature omit the key, causing the page to hide the switch, while `null` returns indicate the build has no presence.

No action is needed, and this change does not alter how the assistant works or any free tier limits.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: product-funnel

ai.title: Lifetime token summary and year card referral actions
ai.summary: The shared account hub types gain a lifetime field on `FreebuffUsageSummary` backed by the new `FreebuffLifetimeTokens` interface, which aggregates free-mode tokens from stored daily rows and live reads. The `summarizeFreebuffLifetimeTokens` utility merges these sources, ignoring stored rows covered by the live read to prevent double-counting, and computes per-day totals within the activity map window. The `year` referral placement and new invite actions (`posted_facebook`, `posted_whatsapp`, `shared_image`, downloaded) support the year in Freebuff card's share flow.
ai.evidence: New exports `FreebuffLifetimeTokens` and `summarizeFreebuffLifetimeTokens` in `common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts` and `common/src/util/freebuff-usage-summary.ts`, plus `year` placement in `product-funnel.ts` and new actions in `theme-referral.ts`.

eli5.text: The shared data definitions for the account's usage history now include a record of every token used across all past days, calculated by combining archived daily totals with the most recent live counts to avoid double-counting. The referral tracking system also recognizes a new spot where you can share a yearly summary card and adds support for posting that card to Facebook and WhatsApp, or saving its image. These changes are in place for the account hub and referral features, allowing the interface to display a complete, accurate picture of your usage and offer more ways to share your progress.

ai.title: Shared notification inbox and preference contracts
ai.summary: Introduces the wire contract for the cloud notifications API in `common`, shared by the server and clients displaying inboxes or pushes. The module defines `NotificationView` for individual items, `NotificationInbox` with pagination via `nextCursor`, and `notificationPreferencePatchSchema` for toggling triggers, where an omitted `trigger` field acts as a global switch. This provides the structural definitions needed for notification rendering and preference management across the Freebuff ecosystem.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/notifications/contracts.ts` introduces `notificationTargetSchema`, `NotificationView`, `NotificationInbox`, and `notificationPreferencePatchSchema` for the `/api/v1/cloud/notifications` endpoint.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show which client packages import these types or when the server-side endpoint implementation is updated to enforce them.

eli5.text: A shared set of rules for how notification inboxes, unread counts, and preference toggles work across the service and its apps has been put in place. This is internal structure for the engineering team; it does not yet display or send anything to users. No new features are visible, and your daily use of the app is unchanged.
